title: Barker Code Generator
text: Generate bipolar Barker Code, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Output sample time; {Code length} sets the length of generated code, {Samples per frame} sets the samples per output frame, {Output data type} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Samples per frame
params.values: Samples per output frame 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
